sourceString.en: Source: Strider Exotic Quest

flavorText.en: And they came to a lake fair and broad. "Lo," said the voice, "yonder is the blade that I spoke of."
flavorText.zh-CN: 于是他们来到一个美丽宽阔的湖边。“瞧，”那声音说道，“我说过的那把剑就在那里。”

sourceString.en: Source: //node.ovrd.AVALON// Exotic Quest
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：//节点.超控.阿瓦隆//异域任务

flavorText.en: The flit of tiny wings; the pull of a trigger.
flavorText.zh-CN: 细翼掠过；扣动扳机。

sourceString.en: Source: "The Final Strand" Exotic Quest
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“最后的缚丝”异域任务

flavorText.en: Thank you for using the Data Analysis, Reconnaissance, and Cooperative Intelligence device. You may call me Darci.
flavorText.zh-CN: 感谢您使用数据分析、侦察及合作智能设备。您可以叫我达西。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: Light is a spectrum. Why limit yourself to a single hue?
flavorText.zh-CN: 光是复色光组成的光谱。那为何还要抓住一种颜色不放？

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "Shame. Guilt. Fear. We all bear them. Gather your regrets, purge them as best you can. Let your enemies feel the weight of your burdens." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “耻辱、存罪、恐惧。我们都在承受。将悔恨收集，尽可能清除它们吧。让敌人感受到你身上重担的重量吧。”——艾达-1

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: Three points, pushed through forever.
flavorText.zh-CN: 三点穿过永恒。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: Perhaps The Final Shape is not silence, it is a symphony.
flavorText.zh-CN: 也许终焉之形不是沉寂，而是交响乐。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 异域 线性融合步枪

sourceString.en: Source: "Salvation's Edge" Raid

flavorText.en: They return from fields afar. The eye has passed, the end nears. Do not fade quietly. Let thunder reign again.
flavorText.zh-CN: 他们从远方归来。目光扫过，结局将至。不要安静消逝，让雷霆再次掌权。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: You will dream of me… I will never leave you…
flavorText.zh-CN: 你会梦见我…我永远不会离开你…

sourceString.en: Source: "Root of Nightmares" Raid

flavorText.en: "I've forgotten so much of my past life, of my family. But when I hold this rifle, everything feels right. I feel like… I'm home." —Ana Bray
flavorText.zh-CN: “对于过去的人生，对于家庭，我已经忘记太多。但当拿起这把步枪时，我觉得一切都那么真切，我觉得……我回家了。”——阿娜·布瑞

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: "My mother had a shotgun we called the Chaperone. Kept us alive out there before we got to the City." —Amanda Holliday
flavorText.zh-CN: “我母亲曾有一把被我们称作监护人的霰弹枪。在我们来到圣城之前，是它保护我们安然无恙。”——阿曼达·霍利迪

sourceString.en: Source: An Exotic quest or challenge.

flavorText.en: By this right alone do I rule.
flavorText.zh-CN: 独凭此权乃为王。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: According to official Vanguard policy, this weapon does not exist.
flavorText.zh-CN: 根据先锋的官方政策，这件武器并不存在。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "The question becomes whether or not to fire, not where to aim." —Osiris
flavorText.zh-CN: “于是问题变成了是不是开枪，而不是该瞄准哪里。”——奥斯里斯

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: The last thing the Vex ever heard—the grinding wails of a vicious Banshee.
flavorText.zh-CN: Vex听到的最后一样东西，是一只堕落女妖的痛苦哀嚎。

sourceString.en: Source: "Lost Lament" Exotic Quest
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“失落的挽歌”异域任务

flavorText.en: "What The Witness gave me, I give to you. May it serve you in death, or in finality. It cannot be both." —Rhulk, disciple of the Witness
flavorText.zh-CN: “见证者给我的，我也给你。愿它在你死亡后或既定后为你效力。二者只能居其一。”——胡克，见证者门徒

sourceString.en: Source: "Vow of the Disciple" Raid

flavorText.en: There must be meaning in my roar.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我的吼声中必定存在意义。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: A light in the dark.
flavorText.zh-CN: 点亮黑暗的一抹亮光。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: "I call it the Zhang Fei. It hits almost as hard as I do." —Wei Ning
flavorText.zh-CN: “我给它起名叫张飞。它出手跟我一样狠。”—韦宁

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "Some things should stay buried."
flavorText.zh-CN: “有些东西就该永远埋藏。”

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "In the Cabal legend, a hero seeks to possess the sun. He succeeds. Then, he becomes Emperor. The Cabal… are not a subtle people." —Tyra Karn
flavorText.zh-CN: “在卡巴尔传说中，一名英雄试图占有太阳。他成功了。接着，他就加冕成为皇帝。卡巴尔们……并不拘小节。”——泰拉·卡恩

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: Property of Ishtar Collective. WARNING: Gravity propulsor beam can cause serious injury or even death.
flavorText.zh-CN: 伊什塔集团财产。警告：引力推进器光束可能造成重伤，甚至死亡。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "Wings flutter. Beauty distracts. Poison injects. The butterfly's curse extends to your enemies. A short life, shortened further by your hand." —Ada-1
flavorText.zh-CN: “扑腾的双翼，美丽令人闪神，随之注入毒液。敌人将遭受到敌人的诅咒。由你造成的那迅速缩短的一生。”——艾达-1

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: Think of space-time as a tapestry on a loom. This weapon is the needle.
flavorText.zh-CN: 将时空想象成织机上的锦缎。武器是针。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "The eye remains open. The Lighthouse remains lit." —Brother Vance
flavorText.zh-CN: “眼睛依然睁开。灯塔依然明亮。”——万斯修士

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "Long, short, they all end the same way." —Katabasis
flavorText.zh-CN: “长也好，短也好，到头来都会在同一天结束。”——冥界旅行

sourceString.en: Source: "Presage" Exotic Quest

flavorText.en: Suffering to the conquered.
flavorText.zh-CN: 被征服者的苦难。

sourceString.en: Source: Dungeon "Duality"

flavorText.en: A voice. A choice. An invitation.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一个声音。一种选择。一份邀请。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Mission Encore

flavorText.en: Potentia ex nihilo.
flavorText.zh-CN: 力量自虚无中来。

sourceString.en: Source: Season Pass Reward

flavorText.en: "His life brought peace to the Reef. His death brings a sword." —Crows of the Black Hull
flavorText.zh-CN: “他的生为暗礁带来和平。他的死换得一柄宝剑。”——黑色船体中的乌鸦

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "I have heralded disaster so often that my mere presence is an omen. So be it." —Eris Morn
flavorText.zh-CN: “我经常预示着灾难，以至于我的出现就是一种噩兆。那就这样吧。”——埃里斯·摩恩

sourceString.en: Source: Season Pass Reward

flavorText.en: "Press on! The Devils will rue the day they came to our doors!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “继续前进！魔鬼都会后悔它们来敲门的那一天！”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: "What kind of harebrained scheme have you got in mind this time?"
flavorText.zh-CN: “这次你又想出了怎样的草率计划呢？”

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: Stalk thy prey and let loose thy talons upon the Darkness.
flavorText.zh-CN: 跟踪你的猎物，然后向暗影伸出你的利爪吧。

sourceString.en: Source: Acquired from Xûr

flavorText.en: We outnumber you. We will find you. You are alone, and we are colony.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们数量超于你。我们会找到你。你孤身一人，而我们群居而生。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "To rend one's enemies is to see them not as equals, but objects—hollow of spirit and meaning." —13th Understanding, 7th Book of Sorrow
flavorText.zh-CN: “撕裂敌人就意味着没有将他们平等对待，但是目标——是精神和意义的空洞。”——《忧愁七书》，第十三次释义

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: "Duality is not a curse, but a gift." —Author unknown
flavorText.zh-CN: “二象性是礼物，而非诅咒。”——无名氏

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: Subroutine IKELOS: Status=complete. MIDNIGHT EXIGENT: Status=still in progress.
flavorText.zh-CN: 子程序似像者：状态=完成。午夜诉求：状态=仍在进行。

itemTypeAndTierDisplayName.zh-CN: 异域 线性融合步枪

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic Archive at the Tower

flavorText.en: There will always be paths to tread and methods to try. Roll with it.
flavorText.zh-CN: 总会有前行的道路和值得尝试的方法。学会适应。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: Calibrate reality. Seek inevitability. Embody divinity.
flavorText.zh-CN: 校准现实。寻求必然。承载神威。

sourceString.en: Source: An Exotic quest or challenge.

flavorText.en: Ionized polymer synballistic attack platform. The system's lethality is dynamically robust across tactical spaces.
flavorText.zh-CN: 离子化聚合物同步弹道攻击平台。该系统的致命性能动态应对所有战术空间。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "You don't know how long I've been looking for you."
flavorText.zh-CN: “你不知道我找你找了多久。”

sourceString.en: Source: Exploring the Pale Heart

flavorText.en: "I have peered through the eye of Chronos to divine humanity's path into the future." —Soteria, the Augurmind
flavorText.zh-CN: “我已透过克罗诺斯之眼预见了人类通向未来的道路。”——占卜思维索特里亚

sourceString.en: Source: "Spire of the Watcher" Dungeon

flavorText.en: Entropy is inevitable.
flavorText.zh-CN: 熵增不可避免。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: We all owe our existence to one singular moment, long ago.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我们的存在都要归功于很久以前的一个独特时刻。

sourceString.en: Source: Exploring the Pale Heart

flavorText.en: The inscription, written in a Cabal dialect, reads: "Inexorable victory."
flavorText.zh-CN: 这句卡巴尔语铭文意为：“不可阻挡的胜利”。

sourceString.en: Source: Exotic engrams; extremely rare world drops.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：异域记忆水晶；极稀有世界掉落。

flavorText.en: "This one made it for you. It brings death yet promises nothing beyond." —Luzaku
flavorText.zh-CN: “鄙人给你做的。它带来死亡，此外不做任何承诺。”——鲁扎库

sourceString.en: Source: Rewards Pass

flavorText.en: …a causal loop within the weapon's mechanism, suggesting that the firing process somehow binds space and time into…
flavorText.zh-CN: …武器机械装置内的一个因果环链，表明开火过程以某种方式把空间和时间结合成…

sourceString.en: Source: "Vault of Glass" Raid

flavorText.en: Three words. Carved by hand: Affinity. Altruism. Awareness.
flavorText.zh-CN: 手刻了三个词：亲缘。利他。认知。

sourceString.en: Source: Pre-order Bonus
